description: Overview The Writeback Grid is a powerful visual tool that allows you to write back changed data to multiple data sources directly from within the Power BI platform in a secure and atomic manner. This functionality is enabled through a backend-agnostic web service that acts as an intermediary between the visual component and your backend, without storing any data. This combination is particularly beneficial for business users and data analysts, as it enhances data quality, streamlines workflows, and allows for manual data population to support data warehousing or machine learning processes directly from within Power BI. Licensing & Pricing The PRO plan follows a per-user model, providing everything needed for the Writeback Grid to function, including the visual component and a fully managed web service. The PREMIUM plan is a per-instance (flat rate) model, offering access to a dedicated web service, fully managed either by us or by yourself, with access to the underlying container image hosted within our container registry. In addition, PREMIUM supports Hybrid Connection Endpoints for easily connecting to on-premises databases, Private Endpoints for enhanced security, and Power BI Embedded to enable access for external customers.
